name: Media
description: AI design, Sharp processing, OCR, batch and storage settings for the Media toolkit.

settings.label: Enable AI design generation
settings.description: Allow AI-powered design generation for media.

settings.label: Default template category
settings.description: Category shown first when browsing design templates.

settings.label: Enable smart tagging
settings.description: Tag uploaded media automatically using AI.

settings.label: Enable remote media sync
settings.description: Synchronise media with remote WordPress sites; requires the Remote Sites toolkit.

settings.label: Max collection size
settings.description: Maximum number of items allowed in one media collection.

settings.label: Sharp processing mode
settings.description: Local uses a bundled Sharp install; microservice offloads processing to a remote Node.js service.

settings.label: Microservice URL
settings.description: Full URL of the Sharp microservice endpoint. Only used in microservice mode.

settings.label: Microservice API key
settings.description: Optional authentication key for the microservice.

settings.label: Processing timeout (seconds)
settings.description: How long to wait for a Sharp operation before giving up. Raise it for very large images.

settings.label: Default image quality
settings.description: Quality for lossy compression, 1-100. Lower values produce smaller files.

settings.label: Enable WebP conversion
settings.description: Generate WebP versions of images alongside the original.

settings.label: Max concurrent operations
settings.description: Simultaneous Sharp operations. Lower values reduce server load.

settings.label: Enable OCR service
settings.description: Extract text from images and scanned PDFs.

settings.label: Primary OCR provider
settings.description: Falls back to the other providers when the primary one fails.

settings.label: Enable image preprocessing
settings.description: Apply grayscale, normalisation, sharpening and noise reduction before OCR.

settings.label: OCR max image dimension (pixels)
settings.description: Images larger than this are resized before OCR.

settings.label: Batch chunk size
settings.description: Images processed per batch. Lower values reduce memory use.

settings.label: Enable background processing
settings.description: Run large batches through WordPress cron instead of the request.

settings.label: Batch operation timeout (seconds)
settings.description: Maximum time allowed for a batch operation.

settings.label: Temporary files location
settings.description: Path relative to the WordPress root for temporary processing files.

settings.label: Auto-cleanup temporary files
settings.description: Delete temporary files once processing finishes.

settings.label: Temp files retention (hours)
settings.description: How long temporary files are kept before automatic cleanup.
